title: Real Madrid sign Ivory Coast's Yan Diomande for record fee from RB Leipzig
facts: Real Madrid signed 19-year-old Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig.
Yan Diomande signed a seven-season contract with Real Madrid running until June 30, 2033.
Spanish media reported the transfer fee for Yan Diomande was a club-record 140 million euros including bonuses.
Yan Diomande represented Ivory Coast at the FIFA World Cup.
Paris Saint-Germain withdrew from pursuing Yan Diomande due to concerns regarding the transfer fee.
Liverpool had a transfer bid for Yan Diomande rejected in June.
Yan Diomande played one season with RB Leipzig in the German Bundesliga.
Yan Diomande transferred to RB Leipzig from Spanish club Leganes in 2025.
Yan Diomande was named Bundesliga young player of the season after scoring 12 goals and providing eight assists.
Real Madrid signed Marc Cucurella during the preseason transfer window.
Real Madrid signed Bernardo Silva during the preseason transfer window.
Real Madrid signed Ibrahima Konate during the preseason transfer window.
Real Madrid signed Denzel Dumfries during the preseason transfer window.
Real Madrid hired Jose Mourinho as head coach to replace Alvaro Arbeloa.
Real Madrid completed two consecutive seasons without winning a major trophy.
